title: Fort George, Grenada
geometryBasis: Fort parade, exterior bastion lines and lower entrance court traced from the 1762 plate using the named mapped site and the standing building footprints for scale and orientation.
sectionBasis: The OAS heritage survey describes intact ramparts and the stepped approach. The Grenada Tourism Authority identifies the parade, barracks, guardhouse and underground casemates. Only the observable standing exterior is represented.
limitations: Wall tops and minor opening details are estimated. The Copernicus surface measures canopy and buildings as well as ground.
The model shows historic masonry and simplified barracks as an exterior. It excludes the hospital, modern exhibits, below-grade rooms and later restoration additions.
